remarks: Two Bedroom 1 bath, dinning room, living room. in good condition. East side/Cove area. Unit is located in the upper part of Seaton Road, near Courtland Avenue. Freshly painted, Kitchen was renovated a couple of years ago with a new refrigerator, Gas Range, Microwave, Dishwasher. Laundry facilities in the complex. Comes with one assigned parking space. Plenty of street parking. Close to the Darien border, I-95 South & North. Walking distance to a city pet park. Walking distance to public transportation, Seller will pay the full  Condo Assessment. Tenant in place, lease expires 10/31/24. Rent increase is coming up. Tenant would like to stay. But, also she will start looking to move.
